assertions.assertion: Each published JSON Schema is a valid Draft 2020-12 schema.
Each positive GIR example validates structurally against gir.schema.json.
Each positive package manifest validates structurally against package-manifest.schema.json.
Every permitted action reference resolves to a declared action marked in_set or conditional.
Every active region contract reference resolves to a declared active CTC.
Every active region has a region-contract mapping entry.
Each active CTC includes all six core semantic components.
Each governance requirement references at least one declared source.
Each active CTC references at least one declared source.
Required evidence IDs are unique within a CTC component/catalog context.
A high-value overlay adding a required approval remains additive under union/conjunction composition.
Fixture with out-of-set action inserted into permitted set is detected.
Fixture removing a required region mapping is detected.
Fixture missing a required CTC component is rejected structurally.
Fixture that replaces union_required evidence composition with last_write_wins is detected.
Stale authorization fixture demonstrates that proposal-time approval cannot substitute for current approval.
False-closure fixture is detected when success closure lacks required target evidence.
Unsound target projection granting undeclared action is classified as authority expansion.
Core profile validates against profile.schema.json.
A conformance claim must include object, version, profiles, scope, evidence basis, limitations/exclusions, and invalidation conditions.
Package conformance is not accepted as evidence of deployment non-bypassability without deployment evidence references.
Unknown mandatory authority/evidence/closure extension causes incompatibility rather than ignore.
Activation of revoked/suspended package is refused.
Authenticated-but-stale evidence does not satisfy a freshness-sensitive requirement.
Successful execution without required post-commit evidence does not produce successful closure.
Conformance output does not claim legal compliance as a derived result.
Release contains no project-specific secrets or prohibited internal-development bleed terms.
Normative requirement identifiers are unique.
Formal property identifiers are unique.
Release manifest hashes all immutable release files except the manifest itself and the generated release-validation report.
